definitions.explanation: The power to affect someone or something.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: To have an effect on the environment.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}に{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I was greatly influenced by him.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}の{影響|えいきょう}で{遅延|ちえん}した。
examples.english: It was delayed due to weather.

notes:
{影響|えいきょう} means influence or effect.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える (give influence, affect)
- {影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける (be influenced)
- {影響|えいきょう}がある (have an influence)
- 〜の{影響|えいきょう}で (due to the influence of)
- {影響|えいきょう}{力|りょく} (influential power)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう} (bad influence)
- いい{影響|えいきょう} (good influence)
- {大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう} (great influence)
